overview.text: Christ Emmanuel represents Christ as a child or young person. Basilica’s explanation links the title with Isaiah’s prophecy and Matthew’s interpretation of Emmanuel as God with us, rather than limiting the image to a particular episode of infancy.

blocks.text: The displayed Russian icon presents the youthful face of Christ within a halo. The object is catalogued at the National Museum of Tatarstan as an eighteenth-century work in tempera on a prepared wooden panel; the photograph carries its own Creative Commons licence.

blocks.text: This catalogue date identifies the particular Russian panel. It should be distinguished from the much earlier scriptural name Emmanuel and from other representations of the child Christ, including Nativity scenes and images with his mother.

blocks.text: Basilica interprets the combination of youthful appearance, mature facial features and a high forehead as expressing both Christ’s human life and divine wisdom. The article explicitly relates the composition to Isaiah 7:14 and Matthew 1:23.
